docs.title: I'm Qazi Ali Hassan — a Data Enthusiast 📊✨
docs.text:
Hello! I'm Qazi Ali Hassan, a mathematics graduate from Sargodha University (2024). While my academic background gave me a solid foundation in logic and numbers, I’ve always been passionate about art, drawing, and calligraphy since childhood.

This unique combination of creativity and analytical thinking naturally led me to the field of Data Science & Analytics. After completing my degree, I ventured into the world of self-learning, exploring Python, Data Analysis, and Visualization tools through online resources and hands-on projects.

docs.title: 🎨 My Creative Side
docs.text: I've always loved subjects that involve multi-step processes leading to a final beautiful result — whether it’s solving a complex math problem or creating an attractive dashboard. That’s why Data Analytics instantly clicked with me. The entire process of collecting, cleaning, exploring, transforming data, and finally presenting insights through meaningful visualizations is something I truly enjoy and never get bored of.

docs.title: 🎯 Current Focus
docs.text:
Currently, I'm actively:

  • Working on personal data projects
  • Sharpening my skills in Python, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, and visualization libraries like Matplotlib and Seaborn
  • Learning and practising data storytelling through visual dashboards and reports.

docs.title: 📖 Favourite Quote
docs.text:
"You only lose when you give up."

This belief comes from my math background — where no matter how many times an answer went wrong, I never gave up until I solved it. I apply the same resilience to data problems and life.

docs.title: 🚀 Future Plans
docs.text:
I aim to step into the professional data world as a Data Analyst, and eventually venture into AI development. My current projects and self-learning are all steps towards that goal.

Let’s Connect & Grow Together!

📊 Projects
docs.text: Here’s a showcase of the data analytics projects I’ve worked on — both personal learning projects and practical data analysis exercises.

docs.title: ✅ Retail Orders Analysis 📦
docs.text:
Description: Analyzed a large retail dataset to uncover trends in customer purchasing patterns, top-selling products, and sales performance across different regions and categories. Performed data cleaning, exploratory data analysis (EDA), and created insightful visualizations using Python, Pandas, Matplotlib, and Seaborn.

Tools/Libraries: Python, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn

GitHub: Retail Orders Analysis

docs.title: ✅ Netflix Dataset Analysis 🎥
docs.text:
Description: Explored Netflix’s movie and TV show dataset to analyze content trends over the years, popular genres, country-wise content distribution, and actors with the most appearances. Developed interactive visualizations and dashboards using Power BI and Python for detailed insights.

Tools/Libraries: Python, Pandas, Seaborn, matplotlib

GitHub: Netflix Analysis

docs.title: 📊 Customer Churn Analysis 📉
docs.text:
Description: Will predict customer churn for a telecom company based on customer behavior and service usage. Planned to use classification models and visualize key customer trends.

Tools/Libraries: Python, Pandas, Matplotlib, Scikit-learn

docs.title: 📊 Sales Forecasting Dashboard 📊
docs.text:
Description: An interactive Power BI dashboard to predict future sales for a retail chain using historical data trends.

Tools/Libraries: Power BI, Excel

docs.title: 📊 COVID-19 Data Tracker 🌍
docs.text:
Description: Will develop a Tableau dashboard to track global COVID-19 statistics, with real-time data updates and country-wise breakdowns.

Tools/Libraries: Tableau, Python

docs.title: 📊 Movie Ratings Sentiment Analysis 🎞️
docs.text:
Description: Plan to perform sentiment analysis on movie reviews using Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques.

Tools/Libraries: Python, NLTK, Pandas

More projects coming soon… 🚀
